operation: Permute frozen selected action labels among rows within each source/category. Each iteration uses the same row permutations for all 3 methods. Outcomes, costs, questions and frozen lambda remain unchanged.
preservation: Exact low/medium/high counts preserved for every method/source/category in every iteration; asserted. Row-specific selected actual cost need not be preserved.
range_meaning: Empirical 2.5th to 97.5th percentiles of random reassignment outcomes conditional on fixed dev rows and action counts; not a confidence interval, training-seed interval, causal estimate, or held-out test.
limit: Questions were used to select objectives and lambda before this post-hoc diagnostic. Source/category invariance and cost equality are not assumed. Do not infer equal-cost superiority from quality differences.
metric_units: Quality and actual cost use each source benchmark original outcome/cost units; no source costs pooled or interpreted as current Claude spend.
